questions.question:
A: What ______ you be in the future?
B: I will be a doctor. I want to help people.
questions.commonMisconception: 慣性選 do，未注意到未來情境時間點。
questions.explanation: 詢問「未來將會」成為什麼，使用未來式助動詞 will。

questions.question: My brother loves planes. He will be a ______ one day.
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識職業詞彙。
questions.explanation: 喜歡飛機的人，夢想職業通常是飛行員 (pilot)。

questions.question: If you like to help sick animals, you will be a ______.
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清 doctor 與 vet 的服務對象。
questions.explanation: 幫助「動物」的醫生是獸醫 (vet)。

questions.question:
A: Will Toby ______ a scientist when he grows up?
B: Yes, he will. He loves science.
questions.commonMisconception: 學生習慣用 am/is/are，不熟悉 be 原形用法。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 之後接「原形動詞」。B 動詞的原形為 be。

questions.question: I ______ have a big pizza for lunch tomorrow. It's my birthday!
questions.commonMisconception: 時態與時間副詞未對應。
questions.explanation: 時間副詞 tomorrow 提示未來式，選用 will。

questions.question:
A: Will they go to Taipei next week?
B: No, they ______. They will go to Tainan.
questions.commonMisconception: 受習慣用語影響選 don't 或 aren't。
questions.explanation: 對 Will 開頭疑問句的否定簡答為 No, they won't (will not)。

questions.question: We ______ work hard to be famous singers.
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 will 與 will be 的後面結構。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 加原形動詞 work。若選 will be 則後方應接 V-ing 或名詞/形容詞。

questions.question: Sam ______ a teacher in ten years. He likes kids.
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉 B 動詞，只選 will。
questions.explanation: in ten years (十年後) 表示未來。成為某種職業需要 B 動詞 be，故選 will be。

questions.question: ______ you ______ help me with my homework tomorrow?
questions.commonMisconception: 結構成分誤用（如 will 配 V-ing）。
questions.explanation: 未來式疑問句結構：Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

questions.question:
Lily wants to be a nurse. Ken wants to be a doctor. They both want to help people in the hospital.
Question: Where will Lily and Ken work in the future?
questions.commonMisconception: 職業與場所對應發生錯誤。
questions.explanation: 護理師和醫生工作的場域通常是在醫院 (hospital)。

questions.question:
It's cold now. I will buy a jacket. It will be hot tomorrow. I will go swimming.
Question: What will I do tomorrow?
questions.commonMisconception: 受第一句 'I will buy a jacket' 影響而忽略時間點對應。
questions.explanation: 文中敘述明天的計畫是 go swimming。

questions.question:
In 2050, robots will do everything for us. They will cook and speak ten languages.
Question: Will robots speak English in 2050?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行「十種語言」與「英語」的包含邏輯推理。
questions.explanation: 機器人會說十種語言 (ten languages)，英語作為主要語言必定包含在內。肯定回答用 Yes, they will。

questions.question:
I like to draw pictures. I don't like to sing. I will be an artist.
Question: Does the writer like music?
questions.commonMisconception: 對問句助動詞與事實推論的雙重判讀錯誤。
questions.explanation: 作者說不喜歡唱歌 (don't like to sing)，暗示不喜歡音樂（或唱歌相關活動）。問句用 Does，回答用 doesn't。

questions.question:
Dr. Wang is a vet. She helps a cat today. She will help a dog tomorrow.
Question: Who is Dr. Wang?
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 vet 或無法進行同義代換。
questions.explanation: vet (獸醫) 的同義解釋即為安 animal doctor。

questions.question: Everyone in our class ______ going to be successful in the future.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 class 或眾多學生的集體感影響誤選 are。
questions.explanation: Everyone 在文法上視為單數，B 動詞用 is。

questions.question: Tom likes to help sick people. He should join the ______ Club.
questions.commonMisconception: 詞義聯想力不足。
questions.explanation: 喜歡助人（病人），最相關的是醫療 (Medical) 社團。

questions.question: I want to buy a new computer next year. I ______ save (存) my money now.
questions.commonMisconception: 對時態的因果連結掌握不夠。
questions.explanation: 為了明年的購買計畫，現在「將要/將會」開始存錢。表達未來意向。

questions.question: If you want to be a great ______, you should practice singing every day.
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯對應錯誤。
questions.explanation: 每天練習唱歌，是為了成為歌手 (singer)。

questions.question: A ______ often travels to different countries by plane.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備職業行為之綜合認知。
questions.explanation: 搭飛機到不同國家的職業最符合的是飛行員 (pilot)。

questions.question:
Let's meet again in 2030! We ______ all be big boys and girls then.
Question: Choose the best words.
questions.commonMisconception: 遺漏未來時間標記。
questions.explanation: 2030 年是未來，助動詞用 will。

questions.question:
A: Do you like the milk tea?
B: No, it's too ______. I only like sugar-free (無糖) tea.
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能分不清 sugar 與 sweet 的關係。
questions.explanation: 不喜歡有糖的奶茶，是因為它「太甜了」(too sweet)。

questions.question: This bowl of noodles is very ______. My face is turning red!
questions.commonMisconception: 將辣與燙混淆。
questions.explanation: 臉變紅 (face is turning red) 通常是吃到很辣 (spicy) 的食物反應。

questions.question: Green mangoes usually taste ______ . They are not ripe (熟) yet.
questions.commonMisconception: 單字義義辨識。
questions.explanation: 未成熟的青芒果味道通常是酸的 (sour)。

questions.question:
A: Can you drink this tea now?
B: No, it is ______ hot to drink. I need to wait.
questions.commonMisconception: 受中文「很熱」影響誤選 very 或 so，未注意到後方的 to drink 結構。
questions.explanation: too ... to ... 句型表示「太...以至於不能...」。

questions.question: These shoes are too small ______ wear. I need a bigger pair.
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞選取錯誤。
questions.explanation: too small to wear 為固定句式結構。

questions.question:
A: Does the soup ______ salty?
B: Yes, it ______ like salt.
questions.commonMisconception: 動詞單複數變換規則不熟。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Does 後接原形 taste；肯定句主詞 it 配單三動詞 tastes。

questions.question: The fish ______ great! My mom is a good cook.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 fish 單複數同型干擾，但在題目語境下通常指單一菜餚。
questions.explanation: 主詞 the fish 為第三人稱單數（在此指這道魚料理），動詞用 tastes。

questions.question: It's too cold ______ out. Let's stay home.
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉不定詞符號 to。
questions.explanation: too ... to [原形動詞] 的結構。

questions.question: Those red apples ______ sweet and juicy.
questions.commonMisconception: 主謂不一致。
questions.explanation: 主詞 Those red apples 為複數，動詞用 taste。

questions.question:
Lemons are sour. Chocolate is sweet. Salt is salty. 
Question: Which one is NOT sweet?
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 NOT。
questions.explanation: 文中指出檸檬是酸的，故非甜的。糖果和糖雖然文中沒提，但常識上是甜的。

questions.question:
The soup is 100 degrees (度). It's too hot to eat right now.
Question: Can you eat the soup now?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法理解 too...to 的否定含義。
questions.explanation: too hot to eat 表示太燙了「不能」吃。

questions.question:
Teacher: 'Don't eat too much candy. It is too sweet for your teeth.' 
Question: Why is candy bad?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊比對錯誤。
questions.explanation: 老師提到糖果「太甜了」對牙齒不好。

questions.question:
I add (加) three peppers (辣椒) into the noodles. Now they are too spicy to finish.
Question: Are the noodles finished?
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯轉向與時態簡答格式。
questions.explanation: too spicy to finish 表示太辣了「吃不完」，所以目前狀態是未完成的 (aren't finished)。問句用 Are 開頭，簡答用 aren't。

questions.question:
We bought popcorn. It tastes salty and buttery. We like it very much.
Question: How does the popcorn taste?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取錯誤，受常見的甜爆米花習慣影響。
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'tastes salty and buttery'。

questions.question: This is ______ extremely (非常) sour lemon. Don't eat it!
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略副詞開頭的母音判斷。
questions.explanation: extremely 以母音開頭，不定冠詞使用 an。

questions.question: The food is ______ for the baby. He can't eat it.
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏因果推理力。
questions.explanation: 因為寶寶「不能吃」，推論食物「太硬了」(too hard)。

questions.question: Oh no! I used salt instead of (代替) sugar. The cake tastes ______ now.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備情境錯誤判斷的詞彙聯想力。
questions.explanation: 誤用了鹽，蛋糕變鹹了 (salty)。

questions.question: Many people like to put cheese on pizza. It ______ cheesy and salty.
questions.commonMisconception: 單複數變動詞形式混淆。
questions.explanation: 形容食物吃起來的味道，主詞 It 配單三動詞 tastes。

questions.question: Pineapples (鳳梨) in Taiwan are very ______ . Everyone likes them.
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解在地產物文化特徵。
questions.explanation: 台灣鳳梨以「甜」著稱，且大眾喜愛，故選 sweet。

questions.question:
Toby: 'This mochi is too sticky (黏) to eat!' 
Question: Can Toby eat the mochi easily?
questions.commonMisconception: 受 easily 詞彙干擾。
questions.explanation: too...to 的句型傳達了「負面/不能」的含義，故 Toby 無法輕易食用。

questions.question: People like to eat ______ on Dragon Boat Festival. They are made of rice.
questions.commonMisconception: 將各節慶食物混淆（如中秋節吃月餅）。
questions.explanation: 端午節的代表性食物是粽子 (zongzi)。

questions.question:
A: What are they doing on the river?
B: They are having a ______ boat race. It's very exciting!
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫或單字辨識錯誤。
questions.explanation: 端午節在河上舉行的比賽是划龍舟 (dragon boat race)。

questions.question: I always ______ my teeth before I go to bed.
questions.commonMisconception: 受中文「洗」牙影響誤用 wash。
questions.explanation: 刷牙的動詞固定用法為 brush (brush one's teeth)。

questions.question:
A: ______ often do you play sports?
B: I play sports every weekend.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 every weekend 時間點誘導誤用 When。
questions.explanation: 詢問頻率使用 How often 句型。

questions.question:
A: Happy Dragon Boat Festival!
B: ______!
questions.commonMisconception: 應答語不夠自然。
questions.explanation: 對方的節慶祝賀，自然回報「你也是」(You too / Same to you)。

questions.question:
A: Does Toby always take a shower in the morning?
B: No, he ______. He takes a shower at night.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 always 影響誤選 A 或格式錯誤。
questions.explanation: 對 Does 開頭問句的否定簡答為 No, he doesn't。

questions.question: It's usually very ______ in Taiwan during the Dragon Boat Festival.
questions.commonMisconception: 氣候與節期感測力弱。
questions.explanation: 端午節通常在六月，台灣的天氣此時通常很熱 (hot)。

questions.question: We ______ red envelopes (紅包) last Chinese New Year.
questions.commonMisconception: 時態未對應時間點。
questions.explanation: 描述過去的節慶活動，使用過去式 got。

questions.question: The dragon boat race is ______ June this year.
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 on (特定日期) 與 in (月份/年份)。
questions.explanation: 在某月份，介係詞使用 in。

questions.question:
Ken: 'I love zongzi because they are yummy.' 
Leo: 'I like moon cakes more. They are sweet.' 
Question: Which festival does Leo like?
questions.commonMisconception: 食物與節慶的關聯推理漏洞。
questions.explanation: 喜歡月餅 (moon cakes) 暗示他喜歡中秋節 (Moon Festival)。

questions.question:
I usually read books on Saturdays. I often play soccer on Sundays. 
Question: What do I DO on weekends?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取不全。
questions.explanation: 整合週六與週日的活動即為週末活動。

questions.question:
On Dragon Boat Festival at noon (中午), people try to make an egg ______ on the floor. 
Question: What do people do with the egg?
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備在地節度習俗的英文化連結。
questions.explanation: 端午節正午「立蛋」是著名的傳統習俗 (stand an egg up)。

questions.question:
Lily gets up at 6:30. Sam gets up at 7:00. Ken gets up at 7:30.
Question: Who gets up the EARLIEST?
questions.commonMisconception: 最高級詞彙理解與時間比較能力的落差。
questions.explanation: 6:30 是當中最的時間，故由 Lily 最早起 (earliest)。

questions.question:
People often hang (掛) sachets (香包) on their necks during Dragon Boat Festival. They ______ good.
Question: Choose the best verb.
questions.commonMisconception: 感官動詞誤用。
questions.explanation: 香包的功能是發散香氣，對應動詞為 smell。

questions.question: My father ______ late for work. He is always on time.
questions.commonMisconception: 頻率副詞位置與語意邏輯雙重判斷錯誤。
questions.explanation: 頻率副詞放在 B 動詞之後。且後方說準時 (on time)，故應為「從不」遲到。

questions.question: Wait! The water is too ______ to swim in. Let's watch from the side.
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏環境安全意識與詞彙連結。
questions.explanation: 「水太...以至於不能下水游泳」最合理的環境限制是水太深 (deep)。

questions.question: If you want to win the dragon boat race, you ______ exercise and be strong.
questions.commonMisconception: 助動詞語意誤判。
questions.explanation: 給予建立優勢的建議，使用情態助動詞 should。

questions.question: In Western culture, people find hidden (隱藏的) ______ on Easter Day.
questions.commonMisconception: 節慶文化對應錯誤。
questions.explanation: 復活節 (Easter) 的傳統是彩蛋 (eggs)，需與端午節立蛋區分。

questions.question: Typical (典型的) breakfasts in Taiwan include soy milk and fan-tuan. They ______ delicious.
questions.commonMisconception: 受單項 food 概念影響誤選 is 或受 tastes 誤導（在此為形容詞 delicious，tastes 後也常用形容詞但主謂需一致）。
questions.explanation: 主詞 They 指代早餐品項（複數），用 B 動詞 are 修飾形容詞 delicious。

questions.question:
Today is June 20th. Dragon Boat Festival is June 22nd.
Question: Is it Dragon Boat Festival the day after tomorrow?
questions.commonMisconception: 時間推算短路。
questions.explanation: 20 號的後天 (day after tomorrow) 是 22 號，正確。

questions.question:
A: Excuse me, how can I ______ to the post office?
B: Go straight for two blocks. It's on your right.
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能將 go to 與 get to 混淆。在此句型中助動詞後方需用原形 get。
questions.explanation: 「如何到達某地」的固定句型為 'How can I get to [place]?'。

questions.question: Don't turn left. Go ______! You will see the bank.
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫錯誤。
questions.explanation: 直走 (Go straight) 是方向指引中最基礎的動詞詞彙。

questions.question: Turn ______ at the corner. The park is next to the bookstore.
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清左轉與直走。
questions.explanation: 在轉角轉彎，選項中只有 left (左轉) 代表轉向動作。

questions.question:
A: How ______ I get to the bank?
B: You can take a bus.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 How do you go to school 習慣影響誤選 do，雖然語法通但 get to 句型常用 can。
questions.explanation: 詢問「如何能夠」抵達，使用助動詞 can。

questions.question: The hospital is ______ your left.
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞誤用。
questions.explanation: 描述「在某人的左/右側」，介係詞固定使用 on (on your left)。

questions.question:
A: Do I turn right at the museum?
B: No, ______ right. Turn left.
questions.commonMisconception: 否定結構不完整或語法錯誤。
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句的結構為 'Don't + 原形動詞'。

questions.question:
A: Is the library far from here?
B: No, it isn't. Just ______ straight for one minute.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 one minute 誘導而誤用進行式或單三。
questions.explanation: 祈使句指示方向，使用原形動詞開頭。

questions.question: There ______ a post office across from the school.
questions.commonMisconception: 主謂不一致。
questions.explanation: There be 句型，主詞 a post office 為單數，故用 is。

questions.question: I want ______ to the supermarket to buy some apples.
questions.commonMisconception: 重複出現的不定詞符號與介係詞混淆。
questions.explanation: want 之後接帶 to 的不定詞。後面另一個 to 是場所介係詞。

questions.question:
Go straight. Turn left at the bookstore. The post office is next to the bookstore.
Question: Where is the post office?
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取錯誤。
questions.explanation: 文中明確表示 'The post office is next to the bookstore'。

questions.question:
The bank is on your left. If you see the park, you went (走過頭) too far.
Question: Is the bank after the park?
questions.commonMisconception: 方位與先後順序邏輯處理不當。
questions.explanation: 看到公園代表走過頭，表示銀行應在公園「之前」。

questions.question:
A: How can I get to Tainan?
B: You can take the train. The train station is across from the museum.
Question: Where is the train station?
questions.commonMisconception: 受首句 Tainan 影響而選了錯誤地點。
questions.explanation: 文中說明火車站位在博物館對面。

questions.question:
The supermarket is two blocks from here. One block is 100 meters.
Question: How far (多遠) is the supermarket?
questions.commonMisconception: 數學單位換算與文本理解結合力不足。
questions.explanation: 兩個街口，一街口 100 公尺，總共 200 公尺。

questions.question:
Amy: 'I'm at the library. It's across from the park.'
Sam: 'I'm at the park now.'
Question: Can Sam see the library?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法建構相對視野的空間感。
questions.explanation: 兩人在對面，Sam 在公園，自然能看到對面的圖書館。

questions.question: ______ at the second (第二個) corner.
questions.commonMisconception: 受中文「右轉」倒置影響誤選 Right turn。
questions.explanation: 祈使句動詞開頭，turn right 為動作習慣表達。

questions.question: The light (紅綠燈) is red. You ______ go straight.
questions.commonMisconception: 交通法規常識與否定詞應用。
questions.explanation: 紅燈不應直走，使用否定助動詞 shouldn't。

questions.question: The post office is closed (關門) today. I ______ get there tomorrow.
questions.commonMisconception: 受 today 影響誤用法。需注意前後句意轉折。
questions.explanation: 今天關門，打算明天再去，使用未來式 will。

questions.question: In Taiwan, many street names use directions, like ______ Road.
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備在地地標文化的英文化認知。
questions.explanation: 台灣路名常包含方位，如 中山「北」路 (North Road)。

questions.question:
Excuse me, where is the office?
It's in the main building (主棟), on the ______ floor.
questions.commonMisconception: 基數詞與序數詞用法混淆。
questions.explanation: 描述樓層使用序數詞 first (一樓)。

questions.question:
A: Is the hospital next to the bank?
B: No, it's across from the bank.
Question: Is the hospital far from the bank?
questions.commonMisconception: 對距離形容詞與方位詞的語感不一致。
questions.explanation: 在對面 (across from) 通常代表只隔一條街，並不「遙遠」(far)。
